reason: Adds a user-facing Focus chat tab that condenses and folds conversation activity while retaining expandable details; the README states it is a pure client-side view with no model requests.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 网页界面添加聚焦会话标签页，将对话活动折叠为便于阅读的摘要，并支持展开查看详细内容。
summaries.en: Adds a Focus chat tab to the dsh web interface that condenses conversation activity into readable summaries with expandable details.

capabilities: Adds a separate focus chat tab to the dsh web GUI
Derives condensed conversation rows from the existing conversation snapshot
Allows users to expand folded conversation details
